title: Vertex AI adds Video 'Pro Edit' and Agent Observability
summary: Vertex AI introduces experimental video editing capabilities and OpenTelemetry-based observability for Agents. Notably, updating an Agent via patch is now a long-running operation.
details: New experimental 'Pro Edit' features for video generation allow developers to modify existing video outputs using text instructions or structured prompts via the `fromOperationId` field. For Agent developers, the new `observabilityConfig` enables OpenTelemetry span emission for monitoring tool usage, model latency, and token counts. Additionally, the `agents.patch` method has transitioned from a synchronous response to a `GoogleLongrunningOperation`, requiring a change in how developers handle agent updates in their CI/CD pipelines or application logic.
